verdict_raw:
Not clean — one real defect, plus a few minor items.

**1. HIGH — Top toolbar is clipped at both edges.** At the far left (x≈0, y≈26) there's an orphaned label cut to "...eye" (likely "Hotkeys"/"Survey" — it's unreadable), and at the far right (x≈1228+) the last item is cut to "Car…". The toolbar overflows the 1280px viewport. Fix: make it horizontally scrollable with edge fade masks, or collapse low-priority items (e.g., Gallery, Time-Lapse, the clipped one) into an overflow "…" menu so nothing is cut at this width.

**2. LOW/verify — Sculpt/BUILD/VIEW floating panel (~x297–437) appears truncated.** "Undergr…", "Pro Too…", "Sun & S…" are cut off. Right now that's just occlusion by the modal (which is normal), but confirm the panel renders its labels in full once the modal closes, and that it doesn't genuinely clip its text at narrower viewports.

**3. LOW — copy check:** the bottom tool row ends with "Innovate" next to Tape Measure / Terrain / Excavate / Analyze. If the intent was a watering tool, that's probably a typo for "Irrigate."

**4. LOW — status bar shows "FPS: —".** Fine while idle, but make sure it populates during interaction rather than staying as a bare placeholder.

**Comprehension (5-second test):** Mostly passes. The modal is self-explanatory — title, one-line description, obvious Play/Close CTAs — and the surrounding context (left catalog, toolbar with "Time-Lapse" visible) makes it inferable why the dialog opened. A first-time user will understand "this previews the build" immediately.

**Misc:** modal is properly centered and doesn't overlap the bottom tool row or the scale bar; compass, zoom stack, and "Daytime" pill are all placed cleanly. Fix the toolbar clipping and this is in good shape.
